# Vendored iOS dependencies

CocoaPods uses these XCFrameworks from the same **0.8.3** releases pinned by both Swift package manifests. Upstream license files are preserved inside each XCFramework.

- YbridOgg: https://github.com/vizoss/ogg-swift/releases/download/0.8.3/YbridOgg.xcframework.zip
  - ZIP SHA-256: `91fe1e6a3236e11462791dc3ff33b3978b463f2fa29a8df9854437c1de74d049`
- YbridOpus: https://github.com/vizoss/opus-swift/releases/download/0.8.3/YbridOpus.xcframework.zip
  - ZIP SHA-256: `48d69ab26218635198c907d760524d53f2804b9eb28a4ef3f0ccabcd1ae01fcc`

The release version above identifies the downloaded artifacts; embedded upstream framework version metadata may differ.
